mapper.select: select cd_id from yz_card_route yz_card_route where cd_state = '1' and cd_lunxun = '1'
select count(*) as cd_count from yz_card_info where channel_id = #{route_id}
mapper.update: update yz_card_route set cd_count =#{cd_count} where cd_id =#{route_id}
mapper.select: select iccid from yz_card_info where channel_id = #{route_id} and status_ShowId = '4'
select msisdn from yz_card_info where iccid = #{iccid}
select cd_code from yz_card_route where cd_id = #{route}
select count(*) from yz_auto_polling where route_id =#{route}
select iccid from yz_auto_polling where route_id=#{route}
select iccid from yz_auto_polling where route_id =#{route} limit #{li} ,100
SELECT cd_status, cd_code, cd_username, cd_pwd, cd_key, cd_control_type FROM yz_card_route where cd_id=#{route}
select p.packet_valid_name from yz_card_info i left JOIN yz_order o on i.iccid = o.iccid left Join yz_card_packet p on o.packet_id = p.packet_id where i.iccid =#{iccid} LIMIT 1
select o.validate_type,o.packet_id,p.packet_valid_name ,p.error_flow from yz_order o LEFT JOIN yz_card_packet p on o.packet_id = p.packet_id where iccid=#{iccid} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: update yz_card_info set used=#{used},remaining=#{remaining} where iccid =#{iccid}
mapper.select: select used,remaining from yz_card_info where iccid =#{iccid}
mapper.update: update yz_auto_polling set day_auto ='1' ,day_type='1' where iccid =#{iccid}
update yz_auto_polling set day_auto ='1' ,day_type='0' where iccid =#{iccid}
